question: Would learning which labelled training comparisons matter add predictive information beyond the entire already deployed ensemble? The current nearest-example voter uses fixed similarity weights at prediction time.
input: Use only the previously elected ensemble's own distinct encoder representations and its training-fold probability records. Resolve all encoder IDs and deployed weights from the autonomous seal. Each encoder separately supplies a new relevance model. No dataset identifier, model name, designated answers or new feature downloads are needed.
candidate: For ordered comparisons, represent a pair by unit change d and unit midpoint m. Use the odd positive semidefinite kernel (d dot d')*((1+m dot m')/2)^2. Select at most 512 label-blind landmarks with one per connected training component, using a deterministic content hash. Use up to ceil(6*sqrt(number of components)). Whiten landmark kernel features by Nyström with eigenvalues above 1e-7 times the largest. Concatenate the unit change and the whitened features, learn a no-intercept logistic predictor with C=1. Reversing the pair negates the decision exactly. These modelling and regularization choices are fixed before the comparison.
election: On the historical primary panel fit one candidate per actual eligible encoder, at most two. Compare shares {0,.25,.5,1} against the complete deployed portfolio using the same strict improvement or paired-near-tie nomination. Pick the eligible candidate with greatest primary correct count, tie by smaller share and then representation identity. Lock source and share before opening its two new confirmation results. If primary does not qualify, stop. With primary improvement, both confirmation deltas must be nonnegative and the two together >=0.30pp. With a primary near-tie, both confirmations must independently improve and the three together >=0.30pp. Stop on the first strictly adverse confirmation. No changing rules based on results.
bounds: Two to four new local logistic fits, at most one per new source/fold, separate from the two supervised blend nominations. No new baseline fits, language-model API calls, designated validation, official test or H2 reads. Report this as a candidate development comparison; a successful candidate would still require fully autonomous entry testing.
